trends.name: Iran War Escalation & Oil Crisis
trends.summary: Middle East conflict intensifying with Polish PM warning of imminent escalation. Russian oil producers declaring force majeure on Baltic supplies after Ukrainian drone attacks on Ust-Luga port, threatening 40% of Russia's export capacity. Macquarie projects oil could hit $200/barrel if Strait of Hormuz closure persists through June, with Iran retaining 67% of its missile arsenal intact.

trends.name: Nasdaq Correction & Market Volatility
trends.summary: Nasdaq 100 has dropped 10% from October highs and entered correction territory. Broad market selloff across all three major indices (S&P 500 -0.48%, Dow -0.61%, Nasdaq -0.61%) as geopolitical tensions and inflation fears weigh on investor sentiment. Technical breakdown signals potential for further downside.

trends.name: Fed Rate Hike Expectations Rising
trends.summary: US 2-year Treasury yield surged to 4.00%, up nearly 60 basis points since Iran war began, signaling market expectations for emergency Fed rate hike. Inflation fears mounting as geopolitical turmoil drives commodity prices higher and wage pressures accelerate. Markets now pricing in potential tightening rather than cuts.

trends.name: Energy & Commodity Price Surge
trends.summary: Oil climbing on Middle East escalation fears and Russian supply disruptions. Fuel cost pressures hitting transportation and cruise operators (Carnival cuts profit outlook, J.B. Hunt monitoring fuel prices). Gold continues outperforming stocks as safe-haven asset amid geopolitical uncertainty and inflation concerns.

trends.name: Luxury & Consumer Discretionary Hit
trends.summary: Iran war wipes out $100 billion from luxury stocks as high-income consumers turn pessimistic. Sony hiking PS5 prices by up to $150 citing global economic pressures. Consumer anxiety accelerating despite strong nominal demand, creating valuation headwinds for discretionary sectors.

trends.name: AI Arms Race & Cybersecurity Disruption
trends.summary: Palo Alto Networks and cybersecurity stocks slide on Anthropic fears as AI model capabilities advance faster than expected. Investors may be overreacting to competitive threats, but sector faces structural concerns from AI-driven disruption. Lumentum positioned beyond AI narrative with broader growth drivers.

trends.name: Federal Reserve Leadership Confirmation Battle
trends.summary: Senate confirmation hearing for Fed chair pick Kevin Warsh becomes contentious as Sen. Elizabeth Warren criticizes him for not learning from past failures. Hearing signals potential friction over Fed independence and rate policy direction amid inflation crisis.

trends.name: Shipping Disruptions & Chinese Trade Concerns
trends.summary: Two Chinese container ships turned back after attempting to exit Persian Gulf via Strait of Hormuz, indicating escalating shipping route risks and trade flow disruptions. Supply chain volatility increasing as geopolitical tensions threaten critical maritime chokepoints.

trends.name: Transportation Sector Margin Pressure
trends.summary: Carnival cuts profit guidance as fuel cost surge offsets record cruise demand, highlighting transportation industry's exposure to energy prices. J.B. Hunt and Garrett Motion also monitoring fuel and cost pressures. Despite strong operational performance, margin compression from inflation is unavoidable.

trends.name: Government Shutdown & Budget Uncertainty
trends.summary: Senate advances DHS bill to avert government shutdown with House vote pending. TSA funding and airport operations hanging in balance. Budget uncertainty adding to broader fiscal concerns amid rising geopolitical spending pressures.

trends.name: Earnings Earnings Mixed Signals
trends.summary: Earnings season shows mixed results with Carnival beating EPS/EBITDA estimates but cutting guidance, ADC Therapeutics discussing clinical progress, and Auxly Cannabis reporting Q4 results. Tech and biotech companies showing resilience but facing valuation compression from rising rates.

trends.name: Consumer Anxiety & Demographic Wealth Shifts
trends.summary: Americans increasingly pessimistic despite high income levels as geopolitical risks mount. New trends emerging: workers quitting early to escape AI displacement, family caregiving reaching $1 trillion annually, reverse mortgage risks surfacing, and wealth transfer planning accelerating. Demographic forces reshaping consumer behavior and financial planning.
